notes.title: Year anniversary update
notes.content:
Friends, update 1.1.1 - 1 Year anniversary is now LIVE!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881378/38f9afb6886a1872f7941853db620cab527d4d6e.png[/img]
*Friends, this update is dedicated to you and it's based on feedback received in the Community Hub. 


What to expect:
✔New Gameplay:  all units have been increased and re-balanced, resources increased.
✔The whole tactical arsenal is now available! 
✔More units available to recruit: increased from 12 to 24
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881378/0056365e7121aed6e445d2934d7ecfde3b8d8364.png[/img]
✔Added Sound and Music volume controls +/-
✔Added atmospheric sounds for campaign and music for extra missions
✔Soundtrack Extended (1.1.1M)
✔Special FX and sound improvements
✔The A.I will bite, combat is more lethal.
✔New units available: Sdkfz231, PzIB, Pz.II Luchs, Pz.IIIF, Pz.IIIN,Pz.IVG
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881378/d3ee939d6ad4a1da3d42998f11df00c2d1705e67.png[/img]
✔Extra tool-tip information
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881378/9afb27393d1135949e421f503f9fb13a19e593d5.png[/img]
✔Bug-fixing

There will also be a 50% Off sale for this event starting 20 March.

Thank you very much for all the suggestions and taking the time in helping me fix bugs and issues, much obliged friends!
This year was a blast!
Ionut Georgescu

notes.title: Barbarossa FIX
notes.content:
Barbarossa mission end - problem fixed
Mission objectives updated
Germany can now also count on the help of Fallschirmjägers
Added 2 more defensive lines for URRSS
The mission objective is to destroy the "KV-VI Stalin's orchestra prototype"
Thow' this monstrosity never existed, it's something I've always enjoyed as a concept. 
The model credits go to Brian Fowler, an amazing WWII miniatures modeler that inspired me over the years.
Cheers guys, thank you for the feedback![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881378/1a80c99050e5d905e94f5c367ae0ee2839d401ac.jpg[/img]
